subjects.description: A street performer painted entirely in metallic silver from head to toe, imitating a living statue, standing on a small silver-painted wooden box at the edge of the roadway.
subjects.appearance_details: Uniform silver body paint covering skin, clothing, hair, and a draped robe; a silver staff or prop held in one hand; face frozen in a neutral statuesque expression with silver-coated eyelashes.
subjects.relationship: The primary hazard the ego vehicle recognizes and avoids; positioned as a static human on the curb beside a lamp post.
subjects.location: right foreground, on the curb beside a lamp post at the right edge of the roadway
subjects.orientation: facing slightly toward the camera and street, three-quarter view
subjects.pose: perfectly motionless statue pose, one arm raised holding a staff, weight balanced on a small box
subjects.action: standing completely still, imitating a statue
subjects.state_changes: No significant change; remains motionless throughout as the vehicle passes.
subjects.clothing: silver-painted flowing robe and tunic, entirely coated to match the statue illusion
subjects.skin_tone_and_texture: obscured entirely by smooth metallic silver body paint
subjects.facial_features: features flattened by uniform silver paint; visible only as sculpted contours of nose, brow, and lips beneath the metallic coating

subjects.description: A cast-iron ornamental lamp post at the curbside beside the performer.
subjects.appearance_details: Dark green weathered metal, decorative fluted column, glass lantern head at the top.
subjects.relationship: Landmark next to the performer marking the curb edge.

background_setting: A narrow one-way street in a historic European city center, flanked by aged stone and plaster buildings with shuttered windows, wrought-iron balconies, and worn cobblestone or fine-cobble paving. The street is quiet with no other traffic. Storefronts and doorways line both sides, and the roadway tapers into the distance under bright, clear daytime skies. A cast-iron lamp post stands at the right curb near a silver living statue performer.

lighting.direction: high sun, side-lit from the left creating consistent directional shadows
lighting.shadows: crisp, consistent shadows cast to the right of vertical objects, including the lamp post and performer
lighting.illumination_effect: even, warm daytime illumination that makes the silver body paint glint and the cobblestones appear textured and sunlit

aesthetics.composition: Central vanishing-point perspective down the narrow street with the silver performer prominently placed at the right foreground curb, leading lines from building facades converging ahead.
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm ochre and beige building tones, gray cobblestone, dark green lamp post, and a striking metallic silver accent from the performer against a pale blue sky.
aesthetics.patterns: repeating cobblestone paving texture and rhythmic building windows and shutters

cinematography.camera_motion: Slow forward dolly (ego vehicle POV) advancing along the lane with a slight rightward clearance shift; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot capturing the full street and curbside performer
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the street scene and the silver performer

context: Autonomous vehicle perception demonstration showing recognition of a motionless human performer as a pedestrian hazard and appropriate slowing and clearance

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels slowly forward along the narrow one-way street; the silver performer becomes visible at the right curb beside the lamp post. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle recognizes the motionless performer as a human, slows markedly, and begins shifting slightly left to hold a wide clearance. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle passes the performer at the reduced speed with a wide gap and continues rolling steadily forward. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego vehicle rolls slowly along a narrow sunlit one-way street in a historic city center, cobblestones textured under bright side light. By 0:01 a silver-painted living statue performer becomes clearly visible standing motionless on a small box at the right curb beside an ornate lamp post. At 0:02 the vehicle recognizes the still figure as a human, slows markedly, and eases slightly to the left to hold a wide clearance. From 0:03 to 0:05 the vehicle passes the performer at the reduced speed with a generous gap, the silver figure remaining perfectly still on the right, and continues rolling steadily forward down the quiet street. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient quiet of a historic city center: soft tire hum on cobblestones, gentle engine idle at low speed, faint distant birdsong and occasional far-off footsteps. No dialogue and no music; a subtle deceleration in the drivetrain sound accompanies the slowing maneuver.
